description: Stations GNSS de l'Observatoire Royal de Belgique is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Observatoire royal de Belgique. The Royal Observatory of Belgium maintains several continuously observing GNSS tracking stations in Belgium. The stations are also belonging to EUREF Permanent Network (EPN) used to maintain the ETRS89 and the observation data are available to the public through. Coverage: Observatoire royal de Belgique. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS Stations of the Royal Observatory of Belgium" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Observatoire royal de Belgique. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2018-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
